senses.sense_definition: The belt-like region of the sky that includes the apparent path of the sun, moon, and planets.

examples.text: Astronomers study the <w>zodiac</w> to track the movement of planets across the night sky.
The sun appears to travel through the <w>zodiac</w> over the course of a year.

senses.sense_definition: The twelve divisions of the sky, each named after a constellation, used in astrology.

examples.text: Many people check their <w>zodiac</w> sign to read their daily horoscope.
Each sign of the <w>zodiac</w> is associated with specific personality traits.

senses.sense_definition: An astrological system used to predict events or describe personality.

examples.text: The Chinese <w>zodiac</w> uses animals to represent different years in a cycle.
Comparing different <w>zodiacs</w> can reveal how various cultures interpret the stars.

senses.sense_definition: A notorious unidentified serial killer active in Northern California in the late 1960s.

examples.text: The identity of the <w>Zodiac</w> remains one of the most famous unsolved mysteries in American history.
Many books and films have been produced about the crimes committed by the <w>Zodiac</w>.

traits.comment: Used as a moniker for a specific individual.
